## Source
.design/m5/43-federation.md — Open Questions Q1–Q5.

## Decisions required (with provisional answers in #105)
- **Q1 transport**: firehose-subscription (A) vs direct push (B) vs hybrid (C). Provisional: A.
- **Q2 trust model**: pairwise allowlist (A) vs web-of-trust (B) vs PKI (C). Provisional: A.
- **Q3 conflict policy**: surface-only (A) vs auto-resolve by trust (B) vs escalate to senior (C). Provisional: A.
- **Q4 context level**: minimal (A) vs +public observations (B) vs +report metadata (C) vs +reasoning text (D). Provisional: B.
- **Q5 withdrawal**: mark-and-lock (A) vs delete-entirely (B) vs allow-continue (C). Provisional: A.

## Rust-quality notes
- Decision issue; no code lands.
- Each decision becomes a `--kind decision` comment on this issue.

## Acceptance
- [ ] All five decisions recorded; this issue closes; PR 1 (#107) unblocks.

## Blocks
- Blocks #107 (Q1 + Q2 shape the transport layer).
